events.description: Three men engage in a violent physical fight inside a restroom stall and adjacent area, involving grappling, throwing, and striking.
One man is pinned and struck by two others inside a confined stall, indicating an attack on a helpless victim during the ongoing fight.
Three men in suits engage in a prolonged, intense physical fight inside a public restroom, involving grappling, throwing, kicking, and striking across multiple stalls and floor space.

Two men in suits engage in a prolonged, intense hand-to-hand combat sequence inside a public restroom, involving grappling, throws, strikes, and dynamic acrobatic maneuvers across multiple stalls and floors.
Three men in suits engage in a fast-paced physical fight in a white restroom; one man in a dark suit attacks two others, leading to one opponent being thrown through a sink.
After recovering, a man in a grey suit grabs a metal pipe from under the sink and resumes fighting, swinging it at an opponent while another man (in dark suit) evades and counters.

Two men in suits engage in a prolonged, intense hand-to-hand fight in a white tiled bathroom. One man (grey suit) attacks with a knife-like object, while the other (dark suit) defends and counters with punches, throws, and grappling. The sequence includes weapon use, blocking, a high kick, a takedown, and repeated close-quarters combat.

Two men in suits engage in a prolonged, intense physical fight in a white bathroom: one man (grey suit) attacks and subdues the other (dark suit), who then recovers and counters with a knife, leading to a struggle where the grey-suited man disarms and overpowers him.
The man in the grey suit violently throws the man in the dark suit to the floor and stands over him while he is downed and unable to defend himself, constituting abuse of a helpless victim.

Three men engage in a sustained physical fight in a white restroom. The combat involves grappling, punching, kicking, and using the environment (stalls, walls) for leverage and evasion. The fight evolves dynamically across frames: initial close-quarters struggle (f0–f2), escalation with strikes and defensive maneuvers (f3–f6), use of stall tops for acrobatic movement (f7–f9), and continued intense hand-to-hand combat (f10–f15). All participants are actively engaged and resisting; no one is clearly helpless.

A man in a black suit engages in a physical fight with another man in a grey suit inside a white restroom; the sequence shows the black-suited man running, initiating contact, and executing a takedown that sends the opponent to the floor.
After the opponent is down, the man in the black suit delivers a forceful strike (likely a punch or knee) to the prone victim’s head/upper body, constituting abuse of a helpless person.
Both men are on the floor under a counter; they appear to be grappling or struggling for position, indicating continued mutual physical combat despite being grounded.
